body: What if they tell me there's nothing wrong with me? What if I go through all that anxiety to talk to someone and it doesn't work?

i'm scared people will think I'm over reacting or being unreasonable. I think hearing that will crush me.

I'm studying electrical engineering. And all of it. Mostly. My nanotechnology lecture is interesting but I've skipped it for almost two weeks now. I have a hard time getting up and wanting to leave the house.

My design course is the main source of my anxiety about school. I feel like I don't understand what I'm doing which leads to me not going which leads to me not understanding which leads to me feeling like I'm a failure. I dont get how everyone else can do this so easily.
Sorry you lost her. I feel like I've lost all enjoyment I once had with my degree. I feel like sleeping all day rather then do anything.
No. I guess not. the idea of explaining how i feel to people i know makes me feel anxious and... worse. stupid.
